en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a broad street lined with large institutional buildings. The main structure on the right is a multi‑storey university building with a corner tower and classical detailing; other similar blocks recede into the distance. A few small figures walk along the sidewalks. The caption at the bottom front identifies the location and institution in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank except for standard postcard address lines and a small Hungarian publisher's imprint at the lower left.
